meta.note: Synced from the Tailwind v4 theme in frontend/src/index.css (14 rendered pages, Oct 2026). The eleven original token names are kept; their values move toward Kibana/EUI conventions. Tokens marked 'added' extend the palette for needs the brief states and the code lacked.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (`--color-bg`). Was #f7f7f5 warm; now the cool, faintly blue page grey Kibana uses so panels read as white on grey.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the header, inputs, dialogs (`--color-card`). Always bordered with `line`; shadow `shadow-panel` optional.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Added. Recessed grounds: the side-nav rail, table header rows, the collapsed state of disclosure groups, selected-row ground in lists.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Code blocks and inline code (`--color-code`). Pair with `code-fg`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders and dividers (`--color-line`). Decorative; never the only cue.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons (`--color-control`). ≥3:1 on `bg` and `card` in both themes. Was #697380.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on every surface (`--color-fg`). Kibana's text grey rather than near-black: softer on long sessions.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: helper lines, metadata, breadcrumbs, labels (`--color-muted`). ≥5:1 on `bg`, `card`, `sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Added. Placeholders and disabled labels only (≈3.3:1). Never body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hue (`--color-accent`): primary button fill, links, selected nav item, current step, focus. Was #2f5fd4. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Added. Hover/pressed of `accent` fills and links.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` (`--color-accent-fg`). Dark theme lightens the accent, so its label is dark.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Added. Selected and hovered grounds: active nav item, pressed chip, hovered table row, the 'See where I was' highlight. Text on it stays `fg`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Added (the code uses `accent` directly). 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element; ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Positive state (`--color-ok`): what was correct, 'Saved', 'ready'. Teal-green so it is never a traffic-light pair with `danger`. Always beside a word or ✓.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Added. Ground of a correct feedback row. Text on it is `fg`.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention state (`--color-warn`): what needs reconsideration, evidence that is stale, a budget nearly spent. Information, not alarm.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Added. Ground of a reconsider feedback row and of an opened hint.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Added. System failures only: model unreachable, ingestion failed, key invalid. Never a learner's wrong answer.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Added. Ground of an error state panel.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Added. Glyph on a solid `ok`, `warn`, `danger` or `accent` dot (the error badge's '!').

tokens.name: evidence-encountered
tokens.usage: Added. Level 1, 'I have seen this': a hollow ring in `control` grey + the word.

tokens.name: evidence-understood
tokens.usage: Added. Level 2, 'I can explain it': a filled disc in the accent blue + the word.

tokens.name: evidence-practised
tokens.usage: Added. Level 3, 'I can use it with guidance': a filled disc in `ok` teal + the word.

tokens.name: evidence-demonstrated
tokens.usage: Added. Level 4, 'I can apply it independently': a filled square in `fg` + the word. The strongest mark is plain ink, not a celebration colour.

tokens.name: evidence-needs-review
tokens.usage: Added. 'Evidence is old or uncertain': an amber diamond + the word.

tokens.name: code-fg
tokens.usage: Added. Code text on `code`.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Added. Syntax: keywords, function names. Same blue as `accent`.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Added. Syntax: strings and numbers.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Added. Syntax: comments; ≥4.5:1 on `code` in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Added. Behind dialogs, flyouts and the mobile nav sheet.

families.mono: "Roboto Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Once per screen: the resume headline on Home and the Welcome-back state. Replaces the mixed text-2xl / text-xl / text-lg page titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Every page's h1, including pages that currently have none (Learning areas, Skill map, Models…). One per page, above the first panel, in the page header row.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and card titles (h2). Replaces text-lg font-semibold.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Sub-sections inside a panel, disclosure summaries, table headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Resuming keeps this session's topic and place.
styles.usage: Default interface copy (= Kibana's 14px base). Buttons, lists, forms, nav.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata under titles, badge and chip text, helper lines. Always `muted`. The floor: nothing smaller than 12px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels that introduce a block ('Last time', 'You stopped before', 'Next useful evidence'). `muted`; at most three per screen.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Semantic search retrieves documents that are conceptually related even when they share no keywords, because query and document are mapped into the same vector space.
styles.usage: Explanations and examples in the Learning Workspace: the code's `.prose` (68ch, 1.75) tightened to 16/26. Max width `measure-prose`.

styles.name: prose-lead
styles.sample: Why can two sentences with no words in common still mean the same thing?
styles.usage: The opening question of a concept or the one-sentence 'what you were investigating' on Welcome back.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “An embedding is a learned coordinate.” — Course notes, week 3

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and the playground editor, on `code` in `code-fg`.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline identifiers in prose; inherits paragraph line height. Not for user-facing option names — those are plain words.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Durations, counts, step indicators, the audio-control readout. Tabular figures keep them from jittering.

spacing.note: 4px base, the same steps as EUI (xs 4 · s 8 · m 12 · base 16 · l 24 · xl 32 · xxl 40). Tailwind equivalents in brackets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: [p-1] Icon-to-label, dot-to-word gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: [p-2] Gap between buttons in a row, between chips; inline code padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: [p-3] Vertical padding of controls; gap between a label and its control; compact-panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: [p-4] Panel padding (the default, like EUI panel 'm'); horizontal padding of buttons; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: [p-6] Padding of the resume panel and dialogs; gap between panels in a page; paragraph gap in prose.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: [p-8] Gap between page sections; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: [p-10] Space under the page header row before the first panel; header bar height is 48px (space-7 + space-2).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: [rounded] Badges, chips, inline code, checkboxes, evidence squares.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: [rounded-md] Buttons, inputs, selects, panels and cards, dialogs — EUI's one radius. Replaces the rounded-lg (8px) cards: panels and controls share a radius.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Representation chips in 'Show it differently', the focus-mode exit control and the health dots. The only pills.

shadow.note: EUI-style layered, low-alpha shadows. Panels get at most `shadow-panel`; only floating layers get more. Replaces the mixed shadow-sm / shadow / shadow-md.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels that should lift slightly off `bg`: the resume panel, recommendation panels. Plain content panels use the border alone.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, the 'More ways to explain' menu, the parked-session pill while open.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dialogs, flyouts (the tablet context sheet), the mobile navigation sheet.

layout.note: Fixed measures so pages stop changing width. Tailwind equivalents in brackets.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Reading column in the Learning Workspace (≈68ch at 16px; the code's `.prose` max-width).

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: [max-w-4xl] The one page width for Home, Learn, Practice, Progress, Explore and every tool page. Replaces the per-page max-w-3xl / max-w-7xl switch.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: [max-w-7xl] Only for two-pane work surfaces: Playground (editor + tutor) and Skill map. Declared by the page, never by a panel.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The top header bar: app name, breadcrumbs, session status, theme/audio controls.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: The collapsible left navigation (expanded). Collapsed: 48px icon rail. Hidden in Focus mode.

tokens.name: context-width
tokens.usage: The right-hand context flyout/column in the Learning Workspace.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects (EUI 'm'). Compact controls inside tables: 32px. Touch: 44px hit area via padding/outline, not taller controls.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of anything interactive.

duration.note: The code already zeroes animation under prefers-reduced-motion and `.reduce-motion`; these are the values when motion is allowed.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, pressed and selected-state changes (EUI 'fast').

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Disclosure open/close, representation swap, popovers (= the code's default 150ms).

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Entering or leaving Focus mode, dialog scrim, flyout slide.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: The code's one easing. No bounce, no overshoot.
